as_told.title: Danny Sheehan's S-force narrative of the JFK assassination

plain: In the 1960s, when John F. Kennedy threatened to scatter the CIA and fire its director Allen Dulles, Dulles is said to have worked from the private banking firm Brown Brothers Harriman to bring back the "S Force", a secret group the businessman Howard Hughes had created, and turn it against Kennedy. Michels tells it twice, each time as the account of a man named Dan Sheehan. In the second telling he adds that the S Force began earlier, with Richard Nixon, then Eisenhower's vice president and head of the 5412 committee, a body overseeing covert operations, working with Hughes, and he ties it to Cuba between 1959 and 1963.
